source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, workflow enrollment lists, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Enrollment, lifecycle movement, audience and email performance were all pulled on Oct 20, 2026. Movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date. The program went live Aug 18 per the Asana launch milestone, and most contacts enrolled in bulk runs from Aug 31.

lifecycle.note_html: Contacts enrolled in a Fall 2026 nurture workflow whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity or Customer) after the day they enrolled. Enrollment comes from each workflow's history (an ever-enrolled list per workflow), not from the nurture_track tag, which is written only when a contact completes the full workflow. Stage entries on the enrollment day itself cannot be ordered against the enrollment and are not counted.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after they enrolled
tiles.cap: 37 in Inquiry Journeys and 10 in Inkwell, out of 6,415 enrollments across the four workflows with contacts. Great First Eight and Agnostic have none yet. 41 are MQL entries; the other 6 entered SQL, Opportunity or Customer only. 6 reached Customer (2 in Inquiry Journeys, 4 in Inkwell, all at the same school).

tiles.label: Contacts enrolled across the four workflows
tiles.cap: 5,838 in progress and 577 no longer active (removed by a suppression list or completed). Inquiry Journeys 3,350, Inkwell 1,986, Agnostic 914, Great First Eight 165. World History has none. The large majority of Inquiry Journeys enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31.

tiles.label: Of Inquiry Journeys contacts moved after enrolling, against 0.5% in Inkwell
tiles.cap: 37 of 3,350 in Inquiry Journeys and 10 of 1,986 in Inkwell. Most of the Aug 31 bulk run has now had eight weeks. Most October enrollees have had under a month, so these rates will keep rising.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts had already entered a lifecycle stage before they enrolled
tiles.cap: 128 in Inquiry Journeys and 229 in Inkwell entered MQL or a later stage between Aug 6 and their enrollment, plus 8 in Great First Eight and 1 in Agnostic. Another 52 did so on the enrollment day itself. For these contacts the content conversion that made them MQL is likely also what enrolled them, so reaching MQL cannot be counted as a nurture result. MQL to SQL is a cleaner test of the nurture.

by_program.moved_note: 37 after the enrollment day: 35 entered MQL, plus 2 whose only new stage was SQL or Customer. 2 reached Customer. 5 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.

10 after the enrollment day: 6 entered MQL and 4 entered Customer only. All 4 of the Customer-only moves are contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close. 29 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 9 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 1 contact entered a stage before they enrolled. 1 enrolled contact has no enrollment date yet.
No contacts enrolled and no emails sent. Cause unconfirmed: the enrollment audience may be empty or the workflow may be off.

coverage.title: What is and is not counted
coverage.html: Enrollment counts come from lists that read each workflow's status, so every program is covered, including Great First Eight and Agnostic, which the nurture_track tag never captured. Two limits. 35 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 5, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no Nurture Enrollment Date yet, so they are counted as enrolled but cannot be counted as moved. Stage at enrollment and the converting form are not recorded yet: the three new contact properties fill in only for contacts who enroll from now on, so movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at.

portfolio.note_html: Nine weeks after the Aug 18 launch, delivery has jumped again since the Oct 13 check (12,680 to 15,996), driven mainly by Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell both crossing a fifth full-volume module. Agnostic's suppression problem has worsened again: the program now suppresses 186% of what it delivers, up from 142% last week, with module 1 alone suppressing more than 3x its own delivery. That is worth checking before reading anything else into Agnostic's numbers.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 12,680 on Oct 13
tiles.cap: IJ 10,724 · Inkwell 4,181 · GF8 472 · Agnostic 619 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 67% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 4,272 unique opens on 15,996 delivered. By program: Inquiry Journeys 27.1%, Inkwell 26.8%, GF8 22.2%, Agnostic 22.0%. Click rate is 1.6% and unsubscribe 0.03%, inside the under-1% guardrail.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 17 of the 49 registered emails have no real volume yet: all 4 World History emails, modules 6 through 8 across Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell (both tracks, including a duplicate module 7 record in Inquiry Journeys), and Great First Eight's module 6. The ones showing 1 or 2 sends are test sends, not audience delivery.

tiles.label: Agnostic suppression rate against delivered, the worst in the portfolio
tiles.cap: 1,151 suppressed against 619 delivered program wide. Module 1 alone suppresses more than 3x what it delivers, 671 suppressed against 217 delivered. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause is not confirmable through the API.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Leadership has sent six modules now, five at full volume (1,138, 1,164, 1,095, 880 and 809 delivered) and module 6 just beginning (20 delivered, too thin to read). Classroom has reached five full-volume modules (1,327, 1,264, 1,188, 941 and 883 delivered), module 5 crossing into real volume for the first time this week. Open rate holds in the low twenties to low thirties across modules 1 through 5, peaking at 31.1% on Classroom module 4. This program carries 67% of portfolio delivery and has 3,350 enrolled contacts, of whom 37 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.1%). The large majority enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31, so that cohort is about eight weeks old and the October enrollees much younger.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: Still the lowest suppression rate in the portfolio by a wide margin (3.8% of delivered, against 24.1% portfolio wide) and open rate stays among the best (26.8%, just behind Inquiry Journeys this week). Classroom and Leadership both reached a fifth full-volume module this week (94 and 175 delivered). Leadership module 1 remains the strongest single open-rate result in the portfolio at 35.6% (309 of 869), narrowly ahead of Leadership module 4's 35.0%. Program-wide unsubscribe sits at 0.41% (17 of 4,181), under the 1% guardrail. Of 1,986 enrolled contacts, 10 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (0.5%); 4 of those 10 are contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Modules 1 through 5 now all have real volume (130, 121, 93, 67 and 59 delivered); module 6 shows 2 sends, which is a test. Clicks remain thin across the program (3 total), so no reliable click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe reads 0.64% (3 of 472), under the 1% guardrail but still thin enough that one or two people move the number. 165 contacts are enrolled and none has moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression is now dominant across the whole program: 1,151 suppressed against 619 delivered program wide, suppressing 186% of what it delivers, up from 142% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses 671 against just 217 delivered, more than 3x its own delivery. Open rate is 22.0% program wide; module 6, sending at real volume for the first time this week, is the strongest performer at 33.3% (9 of 27), though its volume is still thin. Every registered Agnostic email has now sent at real volume. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track immediately; the cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. No contacts are enrolled (its ever-enrolled list is empty), so it shows no movement. The nurture_track__world_history property does not exist, but the enrollment and exit lists read workflow status and do not need it.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (20+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails continue to convert opens to clicks better than its Leadership Track (7.6% average CTOR across five CT emails vs. 3.8% across five LT emails, a gap that has narrowed further to about 2.0x as modules 4 and 5 add volume on both tracks). Inquiry Journeys shows a smaller gap (6.4% CT vs. 5.2% LT, excluding module 6's still-thin 20 sends), narrower than last week as module 5 matures on both tracks.

top_content.note_html: Best email per metric, per program. Click "Details" on any tile for the preview text.

cards.empty_text: No World History email has ever sent, so there is no content to rank. See the program card above.

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell are mostly administrators and coaches, Great First Eight is mostly teachers, and Agnostic is almost entirely unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow.

movement.html: Contacts enrolled in more than one workflow, counted from the four workflow history exports on Oct 13 (Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell share 92 of them). Cross-product re-routing is expected, so these contacts appear in more than one program above. This count is carried forward until the next set of history exports.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys carries 67% of delivery and 37 of its 3,350 enrolled contacts (1.1%) moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling. Inkwell moved 10 of 1,986 (0.5%), 4 of those at the same school on Aug 31, likely a sales close rather than a nurture result. This is not an email-performance problem: open and click rates are healthy. The open question is whether the content is moving contacts who were not already MQL.

Agnostic now suppresses significantly more than it delivers, and the gap is widening. Program wide, 1,151 suppressed against 619 delivered (186%, against 24% portfolio-wide), up from 142% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses more than 3x what it sends (671 suppressed, 217 delivered). Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

Module 5 crossed into real send volume this week across Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell, and Agnostic's module 6 sent at real volume for the first time. Inquiry Journeys Classroom module 5 (883 delivered) and Inkwell Classroom and Leadership module 5 (94 and 175 delivered) all moved past the 20-delivered test threshold, and Agnostic module 6 (27 delivered) means every registered Agnostic email has now sent. Inquiry Journeys Leadership module 6 just started (20 delivered, still too thin to read). Modules 6 through 8 in Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell otherwise remain mostly unsent. Ten weeks post launch on a spaced cadence, more volume is still coming in, but most of the portfolio's history is still early modules.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails and 0 contacts enrolled. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. The missing nurture_track__world_history property no longer blocks tracking, because the lists read workflow status.

The new enrollment fields are not live for everyone yet. 35 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 5, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no enrollment date, and Nurture Stage at Enrollment and Nurture Enrollment Form are empty for every contact until the workflow steps run. Until then movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at, and a fresh set of workflow history exports will fill these in.

Tim's reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is nine weeks overdue in Asana as of Oct 20. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the role property stores internal values (teacher, school leader, district leader) that differ from its display labels, and the nurture_track* tag is written only when a workflow completes, so it is not used for counting. Count enrollment from the ever-enrolled and active lists listed in the workflow registry.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates and the Nurture Enrollment Date property, read through each workflow's ever-enrolled and active lists, pulled Oct 20, 2026) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded, pulled Oct 20, 2026), scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date (the stage entry must fall after the enrollment day). Email window Jul 30 to Oct 20, 2026. Enrolled counts include contacts who have since been removed or completed. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
